title: Zoje ZZ3800-PLB
subtitle: Feed-Off-The-Arm Chainstitch Machine (ZJ3800 Series)

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The Zoje ZZ3800-PLB is a feed-off-the-arm 2-needle, 4-thread chainstitch machine used for denim and heavy-fabric seaming. The 'PLB' suffix most likely indicates a lap-seaming / puller-equipped variant of the Zoje ZJ3800 / ZJ3800-BD feed-off-the-arm series.
applications: Feed-off-the-arm chainstitch seaming on jeans and denim garments
Lap-seaming operations on heavy woven fabrics
Trouser and jeans waistband / seat seaming
Production lines benefiting from a puller-feed for even heavy-fabric feeding
purposeAndApplication.industry: Jeans / denim manufacturing, trouser production, workwear manufacturing

overviewDescription: ⚠️ The exact model code 'ZZ3800-PLB' could not be independently confirmed against a published Zoje catalog. The specifications below are for the closely related Zoje ZJ3800 / ZJ3800-BD feed-off-the-arm chainstitch series, which 'PLB' is most likely a lap-seaming / puller variant of. Please verify the exact suffix against the machine's nameplate. The ZJ3800 series is a 2-needle, 4-thread chainstitch machine with a 6.4 mm needle gauge, max speed of 5,000 sti/min, max stitch length of 4 mm, and bottom-feed connecting-rod feeding system. The BD variant includes an energy-saving AC servo motor with built-in control box and automatic needle positioning.
